headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt still carrying the war, though its rhythm is uneven. Gutter has become the busiest sector, with 73 strategic-base events in 24 hours against 57 in the previous edition; five holdings are Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral, while activity has quickened again in the last two hours. WeatheredExpanse has climbed to 44 daily events from 41, with fighting and enlistments accelerating; its ledger stands at five Warden, two Colonial, and two neutral bases. PalantineBerm has edged up to 24 events, including two in the latest two hours, and retains six Colonial and one neutral holding. NevishLine remains active but has eased to 21 daily events from 27, with three recent events and all eight bases still Warden. MarbanHollow holds at 20 daily events, though its last two hours were quiet, while StlicanShelf reports ten events and sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments. Heavy action also continues in CallahansPassage and Stonecradle without recorded base events. The war remains undecided.
